jobs.title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
jobs.description: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits Â About Sodalis Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs. Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. jobs.description: Role: Head of Engineering Company: xpate Location: London or remote Job Type: Full-time About xpate xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore. The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand. xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents. What you will do Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team. Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors. Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts. Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later. Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision. Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own. First 6 months Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter. Months 4–6: build the harness on top, so non-engineering teams can prompt agents, create their own tools and run their workflows. What you need to succeed You have built financial systems: ledger, reconciliation, processing, gateway, double-entry accounting. Ideally you wrote them yourself, and you know what a few cents of error cost at scale. You have a strong data architecture background. You can hold the full technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors. You are a senior engineer with proven results. Team size doesn’t matter – leading 4–5 people is fine. You know code quality and review still matter, and you are ready to change how the work gets done. You think and talk like a business person. You are a mature operator: collaborative, transparent, no “I know best”. You change things carefully and still make bold calls. Payments or acquiring background is not required – any financial systems experience works. Nice to have: you have rebuilt or transformed a team before. Nice to have: you are based in London. What you get A new role with a clear mission: transform the platform and the way the company works. Direct work with the founders, reporting to the CEO. A team of about 15 engineers to inherit and reshape. A profitable company moving into Payfac-as-a-Service and embedded distribution. An AI-native setup where non-engineers build their own tools. Year 1 is fixed pay. From year 2, shadow equity tied to P&L performance, with a path to real equity. Details to be agreed. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This role is focused on research , including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave , and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects. We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions. How you’ll work You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform. You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence. You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab. Key responsibilities: Hybrid bioprocess modelling Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data. Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics. Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data. Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations. Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings. Transfer across organisms and scales Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast. Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data. Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up. Real-time Model-Predictive Control Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically. Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation). Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity. Qualifications: PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience. Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish. jobs.title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you. Team Culture We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it. About the Role As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training. Your Responsibilities Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency. Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale. Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures. Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team. Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions. Core Qualifications You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch. You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects. You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do. We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew. To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage. You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Automotive
jobs.description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About the role You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in EMEA, working hand in hand with our Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year. These deals are built on a foundation of understanding multiple technical and business stakeholders, from individual engineers, to leadership and C-suite. You will need to spend time understanding what an engineering team is battling, what the program manager is worried about, how to gain support and buy in from procurement and purchasing teams, and what the CTO is trying to achieve at a strategic level, then pull these threads together to build a successful deal. You'll work hand in hand with solution engineering and business development teams to shape, build and close deals. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit. At Applied Intuition, you will: Own critical client relationships and expand reach into key accounts including major OEM and Tier 1 relationships. Drive strategic alignment and executive engagement across R&D, procurement and other relevant teams Grow current footprint across Applied Intuition's solutions and land multi year commercial deals, including securing renewal risks We're looking for someone who has: Bachelor's degree 5-10 years of experience automotive software / platform / semiconductor sales into Automotive OEMs Track record of securing large scale, multi year software deals Strong knowledge of a complex software sales process, including ability to map stakeholders, leverage key contacts and drive progress through legal, following up and maintaining CRM hygiene Nice to have: Technical fluency around Software Defined Vehicle technical topics, ADAS/AD, ADAS validation, SIL/HIL toolchains Ability to have a technical conversation without the presence of a solution engineer Strong network inside at least one or more major European Automotive OEMs Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or comparable Engineering subject MBA Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment. Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum int

Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to a client stakeholder without jargon. Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; forward deployed work is inherently unstructured. Willingness to travel to client sites. jobs.title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials. Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations. Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure. Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment. Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team. Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams. Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them. Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions. Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates. Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes. Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures. Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result. Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor. Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection. Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners. Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division. Your Profile: Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering. 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries. Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and cera

jobs.title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight. This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence. Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware. Your Day-to-Day: Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits. Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements. Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors. Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies. Define the PCB architecture and layout constraints for multilayer HDI assemblies, including fine-pitch components, microvias, grounding, signal and power integrity, EMC, thermal management, creepage and clearance. Perform circuit simulation, tolerance analysis, worst-case circuit analysis, component derating, FMEA/FMECA and reliability assessment. Work with Systems and Safety Engineering to implement fault detection, diagnostic coverage, independence and safe-state behaviour in accordance with the allocated Design Assurance Level. Develop and maintain DO-254/ED-80 lifecycle evidence, including hardware requirements, design data, traceability, verification results, review records and problem reports. Lead prototype bring-up, debugging, integration and fault-injection testing using cell simulators and flight-representative hardware. Support DO-160G environmental and EMC qualification, DO-311A battery-system testing and transfer into repeatable production through DFM, DFT and manufacturing-test development. Collaborate closely with BMS software, battery systems, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, testing, manufacturing and certification teams. Lead hardware design reviews, resolve test and production failures and mentor less-experienced engineers. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related field. Seven or more years of experience developing complex electronic hardware from architecture through verification and production release. Proven experience with BMS hardware, battery-monitoring electronics or comparable high-channel-count, safety-critical mixed-signal systems. Strong expertise in precision analogue measurement, ADC signal chains, filtering, current and voltage sensing, galvanic isolation and fault-tolerant power supplies. Demonstrable experience designing high-density multilayer electronics, including HDI technology, fine-pitch BGA/QFN devices, microvias, power distribution, grounding and thermal constraints. Strong digital-hardware knowledge involving microcontrollers, memories, watchdogs, CAN/CAN FD, SPI, I²C and isolated serial interfaces. Hands-on experience developing airborne electronic hardware under DO-254/ED-80 is essential. Experience at DAL B or DAL A and supporting formal certification reviews is strongly preferred. Proficiency with professional ECAD and simulation tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence, Siemens EDA, LTspice or equivalent. Altium experience is preferred. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable. Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit. Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely with the HV Electrical Systems team and the Electrical Systems Architect. Design cell interconnections and busbars as well as develop the cell connection system together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team. Specify and select protection and safety devices, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge components, current sensors, manual service disconnects, and the HV interlock loop, working with Airborne Electronics colleagues where solid-state power controllers (SSPCs) are used. Define the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces of each unit together with the HV Electrical Systems team. Own the grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design within each unit. Define the physical layout and routing of electrical components together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team. Perform safety analyses such as FMEA for each unit or support the Safety team in system-level safety assessments. Draft test requirements (TRQs) for electrical verification, independently or together with the respective teams as required. Create and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, requirements, and interface definitions under configuration control, and contribute to design reviews and certification evidence. jobs.description: Senior Brand Designer OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! BRAND CREATIVE @ CARWOW Brand Creative is the central creative studio for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, craft and collaboration. We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building. We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and creative exploration. YOUR MISSION Your mission is to elevate how our brands show up visually; taking ownership of everything from early creative concepts to final delivery across a wide mix of channels. As the sole permanent designer in the team, you will play a central role in shaping how we communicate visually, balancing conceptual thinking with hands-on craft, and ensuring our brands remain consistent, recognisable and creatively ambitious. You will support onboarding and coaching our freelancers in the guidelines and internal systems, taking ownership of both. You’ll collaborate closely with marketing, content, product and editorial teams, while being confident operating independently, solving problems proactively and bringing structure to a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll also be an active contributor to our Creative Community, helping connect, inspire and align creatives across the wider business (there are plenty of creative pockets at Carwow Group!). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Deliver high-quality design across brand, campaign, social, print, CRM, paid media and editorial channels. Partner with the Head of Creative, Creative Strategist and Copywriters to develop clear, insight-led creative ideas and campaign directions. Interpret brand guidelines pragmatically, knowing when to follow, when to adapt and when to propose improvements. Produce assets that scale: layouts, toolkits, templates and visual systems that support efficiency across the group. Concept and create social-first paid video content that reflects platform behaviours and audience expectations, particularly across YouTube and Meta. Work with Product Designers to ensure brand and campaign creative translates effectively into digital journeys. Present your work with clarity, explaining rationale, constraints, and the impact of design decisions. Provide constructive, objective feedback to freelancers and ensure their work aligns with brand expectations. Bring structure and consistency to design delivery through thoughtful file organisation, templating and process improvements. Contribute actively to Carwow’s Creative Community, sharing inspiration, collaborating across teams and helping strengthen our creative culture. Proactively explore AI solutions in the creative workflow without compromising on execution. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. jobs.description: Role : Founding Design Engineer (Senior / Staff) Company : CodeSpeak Location : London, on-site. Ideally you already live in London. Candidates based elsewhere are welcome to apply, and remote is possible for a very strong candidate, but UK-based candidates come first. Candidates with a Global Talent visa, granted or in process, are a good fit. Job Type : Full-time About CodeSpeak Agents write more code every month. Human brains stay the same. CodeSpeak is building a program model that sits one level above code, so people can see how a program works and changes over time without reading much of it. The goal is to give control back to the developer: you think about architecture, and the routine goes away. CodeSpeak was founded by Andrey Breslav, the creator of Kotlin, which millions of developers use daily. Around him is a team that has built the tools other engineers rely on, at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph, and Elastic. When it comes to program analysis and developer tooling, these are some of the best people in the world. CodeSpeak is backed by Accel and by funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, and funding covers several years. Here is the open problem. The team has a fair idea of what the program model should look like. It does not yet know how to visualise it. As Founding Design Engineer you will decide how it looks, then build it and ship it. The core engineering team has just been hired, and nobody on it has design-engineering skills. You are the missing piece. CodeSpeak is a UK company. It has no business in Russia and no ties to Russian companies. It is still testing which problems it can solve best, so priorities may shift. What you are expected to do: Design and delivery Own how people interact with CodeSpeak: in the CLI, on the web and on any future platform. Design the interfaces yourself. Build many prototypes, decide on the right UX and ship the result. Harden the prototypes users liked, so they hold up on real data, with the same care for performance and product quality as for design. Ship features to production without help from the rest of the team. Product problems CodeSpeak works with unusually complex information: developer intent, requirements, code, architecture, the relationships between them, how they change over time, contradictions and dependencies. The job is not to display it, but to help developers understand it, navigate it and act on it. Find a way to visualise CodeSpeak's new, higher-level program model. In your first 30 days, visualise the architecture of a codebase split into components. Go deeper from there: a single component, its diff and its code review. Then interfaces that let developers navigate structured requirements and how they relate to each other, review requirements alongside code review, see how requirements map onto parts of the codebase, explore how intent, architecture and code change over time, browse agent sessions, find contradictions between requirements, and edit and reorganise requirements rather than only view them. Web UI is the simplest and most obvious platform. Some of this will live in the console. VS Code plugins and other desktop frameworks may follow, and the final scope is still open. Ways of working Find tasks and clarify requirements without waiting for a brief. Nobody will micromanage you. Egor and Andrey give general direction. Work directly with the founder and the engineering team to turn early ideas and hypotheses into intuitive, interactive product experiences. Take part in design meetings, where many decisions are made on the spot. Explain and defend your design decisions to Egor and Andrey. Both hold strong opinions, and both argue hard. Argue for your tasks, and step back with good grace if the team disagrees. What you need to succeed: Craft You can design an interface, prototype it and ship it to production on your own. Working closely with our Superintendent Pharmacist, you will help shape the future of our pharmacy, strengthen professional standards and support the delivery of safe, effective patient care at scale. We are looking for someone who is confident in their clinical and regulatory knowledge, understands the importance of patient safety and is ready to take on a position with significant accountability, influence and leadership. Our pharmacy processes over 50,000 prescriptions each month, with continued month-on-month growth of approximately 10%. You will take a leading role in the day-to-day clinical operation of the pharmacy, providing specialist regulatory expertise in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs, supporting professional standards and ensuring patient safety remains central to everything we do. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. Job Overview We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution. As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery. Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate. While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. jobs.title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience. You should apply if these excite you: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy. High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation. You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won't be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best. Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies. In this role, you will:   Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving. Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar. Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence. Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience. Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions. Champion diversity, equity and inclusion through impactful hiring programs. Work with People, Legal, Finance and Mobility to streamline hiring, including country-specific requirements. Mentor peers and foster a culture of learning in the recruitment team. Embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale. Minimum requirements for the role: You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar. You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA. You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way. You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population

jobs.title: AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech
jobs.description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds. The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe. We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations. Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build. Why this role, why now AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly. Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do. The mission We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective: Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today. Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow. Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two: 80%: deploy AI inside our ventures Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved. Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks. Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides. Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring. Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once. 20%: studio radar and partnerships Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a Statistics team overseeing Real-World Evidence (RWE), non-interventional, and Secondary Use of Data (SUD) studies. You will provide statistical leadership, review study protocols and analysis plans, supervise external service providers, ensure the quality and timely delivery of statistical outputs, and work closely with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation and regulatory reporting Key Responsibilities : - Review study synopses and protocols, including sample size calculations, study design, endpoints, and statistical methodologies. - Oversee statistical deliverables from external service providers, including Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), TFLs, and interim analyses. - Monitor study statistical milestones and track operational progress through vendor dashboards. - Ensure the timely delivery of statistical outputs and analysis datasets in compliance with Ipsen quality standards. - Perform quality control of statistical analyses, including SAS programming and programming validation activities. - Review clinical study reports (CSRs) and all external communications related to study results and analyses. - Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Biometry, Clinical Operations, Medical teams, and external partners. - Ensure complete and accurate maintenance of study documentation, including accountability for eTMF completion. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional and international environment. Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01), avec 2 jours par semaine sur site et des déplacements ponctuels à Aix-en-Provence. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Ingénieur.e de recherche (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
jobs.description: Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite. ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables. Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).   DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne. Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis. Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales. L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie. Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables. jobs.description: English version Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable . C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l' Institut Mines-Télécom , forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif. L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. jobs.description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.   Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).   Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche. Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie. Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous :          Préparer et mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode pour des systèmes de stockage électrochimique de l’énergie.  Réaliser des mesures électrochimiques afin d’évaluer les propriétés et les performances des matériaux étudiés.  Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux, puis contribuer à l’optimisation des protocoles de préparation et de caractérisation. Présenter les résultats obtenus et participer aux discussions scientifiques autour du projet. 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.   Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver : Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST). Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an. Identifier les populations, métiers ou entités nécessitant une attention particulière et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles. Développer des analyses permettant d'évaluer l'efficacité des politiques RH et d'en mesurer les résultats. Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers. C. Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats. Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - BeReal
jobs.description: About Voodoo Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz. Team At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions. Role We’ve built BeReal with a tiny technology team of world-class engineers and we intend to keep this mindset as we scale it to hundreds of millions of users. To achieve this, we ship new features faster than any other scaled social network while upgrading our infrastructure. We work in small teams of generalists and give each engineer high autonomy to make product related decisions. Tackle exciting technical challenges, given the nature of our product, which experiences spikes of millions of users connecting within a 2-minute window. Contribute to the development of a robust architecture capable of supporting massive scale as we attract new users and expand to new countries. Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to create new features for the app. Analyze trade-offs and address technical challenges related to key components of our backend. Participate in code and design reviews. Our Stack Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Pub/Sub, GitHub actions, and ArgoCD. Backend: Go, Node.js (NestJS, Nx, Typescript) Frontend: Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android). Database: Spanner, PostgreSQL, Redis. Profile You have 5+ years of experience working on API on distributed architecture. You have a proven experience in Go and contribute to developing high volume API microservices. You are self-reliant and have prior experience in a startup or similar environment. You value teamwork and thrive on challenges. You are proficient in English as our team is diverse and international. You have a master degree in computer science or related field. Most importantly, you believe in the project, are motivated, and eager to embark on an exciting and challenging journey. Benefits Competitive salary upon experience Swile Lunch voucher Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo) Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family is 100% borne by Voodoo Wellness activities in our Paris office Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss. Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead. Why join us Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed. We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build. Our values Care We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship. Bias for Action We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory. Ownership We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results. This Account Executive role at Prelude is a hunting position, built for an outbound-first seller who thrives on prospecting and knows how to move fast. You’ll close SMB deals at volume across multiple industries and own the full cycle from A to Z, including your own prospecting, demos, and negotiation. Because you’ll handle technical stakeholders directly, you’ll also become a true expert in our product. What will you be doing? At least 2 to 3 years in a closing role running a full outbound sales cycle with a track record of closing high-volume SMB deals A strong outbound background, ideally as a BDR or SDR - you’re comfortable picking up the phone 50+ times a day and know how to hook a prospect in the first 30 seconds SaaS sales experience is a must - you know what an API is and can hold your own in a conversation with a technical buyer Consistent quota attainment and overachievement A hunter mindset and the ownership to build your own pipeline and drive your own metrics Sharp, instinctive discovery skills - you can uncover pain efficiently Curiosity and the drive to become a product expert, so every conversation is relevant and consultative Fluency in English Familiarity with HubSpot is a nice to have Genuine excitement for what Prelude is building What do we offer? Competitive base salary with uncapped commission + BSPCEs Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office in Paris, 1 day remote High-end gear and ergonomic setup 100% travel subsidised to our Paris office Private health insurance Swile meal vouchers Gym pass Annual offsites in great locations The opportunity to be part of building something big, from the start! Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond. Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month. Fluent in internet.
