We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Please apply with a CV in the English Language. This is a Paris-based role with global reach and therefore Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) is important. Role Summary Checkout.com is seeking a talented and dynamic Legal Counsel with a strong French employment law background to join our Employment Legal team. This role will involve advising on the full spectrum of employment law issues across our French business and supporting broader global employment law initiatives, especially across other EMEA jurisdictions. You will work closely with our People Team and key business stakeholders in France and internationally. This is a great opportunity to support and develop our French employment legal strategy while collaborating as part of a global team supporting employees across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. You will take a consultative and commercial approach to handling complex Labor Code compliance matters, works council (CSE) consultations, litigation, employee relations, and strategic projects across France. You’ll also advise on individual and collective dismissals, restructurings, settlement negotiations, performance management, misconduct investigations and HR audits. You’ll monitor legal and regulatory developments across EMEA and provide proactive guidance on emerging risks and legal requirements. You’ll also help the employment legal team develop scalable processes, templates, and compliance frameworks, including through the use of AI tools. You will be able to handle multiple areas of responsibilities autonomously, demonstrating excellent critical judgment with hands-on approach. You will report into our Associate General Counsel (Head of Employment) based in London. You will also work closely with the regional People Team leads, based in France and other EMEA jurisdictions. You will be joining a high-achieving legal team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be the best legal team in the world, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business. Essential Qualifications: French qualified lawyer (Avocat admitted to the French Bar or Master 2 in French Employment Law / Droit du Travail) 5+ years experience specializing in French employment law, either in a reputable law firm or in-house Fluency in French and English (both written and spoken) with the ability to articulate complex legal issues clearly to non-French leadership. Within a commutable distance from our Paris office and comfortable working in the office as necessary under our hybrid working policy (currently three days per week on scheduled office days). Strong candidates will demonstrate the following: Experience as in-house employment counsel, ideally in a large global business headquartered outside of France. jobs.title: Développeur BI & Data F/H/X - CDI 39h
jobs.description: Le Sud-Ouest pour ancrage, la glisse pour terrain de jeu, la passion comme ADN partagé. OneTurn vit et respire la culture outdoor et les sports d'action en portant des marques emblématiques comme Volcom, Spyder, Aspen, Etnies, éS et Emerica et pour certaines depuis plus de 30 ans. Des femmes et des hommes qui connaissent ces univers de l'intérieur, qui les vivent au quotidien et mettent toute leur énergie pour les incarner avec ambition. Sous la responsabilité du Responsable Systèmes d’Information & Projets F/H/X, le Développeur Data & BI F/H/X conçoit, maintient et fait évoluer le data warehouse, les interfaces entre les systèmes et les rapports Power BI du groupe. Il contribue au sein de la DSI, à la trajectoire data du groupe. À ce titre, ses missions principales sont les suivantes : Data & Systèmes d’information o Maintenir et faire évoluer le data warehouse SQL Server. o Extraire et exploiter les données issues des applications métier (ERP, PLM, PIM, CMS, e-com, B2B, POS). o Superviser l’exécution des flux (monitoring, alerting), traiter les incidents et documenter chaque flux (source, cible, déclencheur, procédure de reprise). o Contrôler et fiabiliser la qualité et la cohérence des données ; participer à la gouvernance et à la structuration des données. Développement, automatisation & intégration o Concevoir et maintenir les automatisations et intégrations entre le SI et les systèmes tiers (T-SQL, API REST / JSON, n8n, packages SSIS existants). o Développer et optimiser les procédures et fonctions T-SQL. o Développer des interfaces d’accès aux données simples et performantes : vues, API, exports, serveurs MCP (accès gouverné, lecture seule, gestion des droits). o Rationaliser l’existant : inventorier, migrer ou supprimer les traitements isolés (jobs, vues, fonctions, packages SSIS, scripts), centraliser l’ordonnancement. o Contribuer aux choix d’architecture data. BI & Analytics o Concevoir, développer et maintenir les tableaux de bord Power BI. o Concevoir et faire évoluer les modèles sémantiques Power BI. o Identifier des leviers d’amélioration à partir des données et produire des analyses ponctuelles pour éclairer les décisions. o Animer avec le DSI, la roadmap Data & Analytics : backlog priorisé, revue régulière avec les référents métier, communication des livraisons. Accompagnement métier & support o Comprendre les besoins des équipes opérationnelles et les traduire en solutions techniques. o Prendre en charge le suivi des tickets et demandes d’assistance sur le périmètre data, intégration et outils internes, avec une priorisation partagée avec le DSI. o Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’exploitation des outils de reporting et leur montée en autonomie (self-service encadré). o Contribuer à l’acculturation Data au sein de l’entreprise : bonnes pratiques, diffusion des usages. PROFIL – Le(a) candidat(e) de nos rêves Formation : Bac+3 à Bac+5 en data engineering ; Expérience : 3 à 6 ans d’expérience en développement BI / data engineering dans un domaine similaire ; Compétences : Maîtrise de SQL Server : T-SQL avancé (procédures, fonctions, optimisation), SQL Agent ; capacité à maintenir des packages SSIS existants (SQL Graph apprécié). Maîtrise de Power BI : modèles sémantiques, DAX, administration des datasets et de la gateway. Pratique des API REST / JSON, GraphQL et d’un outil d’orchestration (n8n ou équivalent) ; Python apprécié. Connaissance de l’écosystème Microsoft Fabric / Azure. Appétence pour l’IA appliquée aux données (MCP, RAG). Connaissance des données d’une marque multicanale appréciée : cycle de vie produit (PLM, PIM), ER

Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . jobs.description: Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first) Team description Our Paris sales team helps small and growing merchants across France get set up with SumUp's payment tools, often as their very first introduction to the brand. jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it. While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 20k to € 200k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.  Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs)

jobs.title: Alternant(e) Expert en Ingénierie des Données / Data Engineer H/F
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? KAISCHOOL est une école supérieure spécialisée en Intelligence Artificielle, Data, Cybersécurité et Commerce IT. Elle forme du Bac+3 au Bac+5 en alternance, en mode hybride. Pour développer ses activités data, KAISCHOOL recrute un(e) alternant(e) Expert en Ingénierie des Données. Vous travaillerez sur nos propres projets et préparerez votre diplôme dans notre école. Votre formation : Expert en infrastructure de données massives (Bac+5) Il s’agit d’une certification de niveau 7 (Bac+5), enregistrée au RNCP sous le n° 37638 et délivrée par Simplon. Elle forme des experts capables de concevoir, déployer et gouverner des systèmes de données à grande échelle. La formation couvre toute la chaîne, de l’étude de faisabilité jusqu’au data warehouse et au data lake. Vous apprendrez à : concevoir et administrer des infrastructures de données massives ; construire des pipelines de collecte, de traitement et de distribution des données ; créer et maintenir des entrepôts de données et des data lakes ; industrialiser les traitements avec CI/CD et DevOps Data ; déployer sur des environnements cloud public, privé, multicloud ou on-premise ; assurer la qualité, la sécurité et la conformité RGPD des données ; piloter un projet data de bout en bout. Technologies : Python, SQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, cloud. Les + de KAISCHOOL : formation 100 % gratuite pour vous, financée par l’OPCO, et salaire versé pendant toute l’alternance ; pédagogie hybride : cours sur place à Fontenay-sous-Bois et plateforme en ligne avec replays 24h/24 ; 15 projets concrets par étudiant ; plus de 30 docteurs (PhD) en IA parmi les intervenants ; école certifiée Qualiopi ; 95 % d’insertion à 6 mois (promotion 2024, donnée déclarative de l’école). Vos missions : participer à la conception et à l’évolution de notre architecture de données ; développer et maintenir des pipelines d’ingestion et de transformation (ETL/ELT) ; intégrer des données venant de sources variées : CRM, plateformes pédagogiques, outils internes ; contribuer à la mise en place et à l’alimentation d’un entrepôt de données ; contrôler la qualité des données et surveiller les flux ; automatiser les traitements et participer au déploiement cloud ; documenter les jeux de données, les flux et les procédures ; travailler avec les équipes métiers et data pour mettre les données à leur disposition. Profil recherché : vous avez un Bac+3 dans une filière technique : informatique, data, mathématiques appliquées, MIAGE, ingénierie logicielle, etc. ; vous maîtrisez bien Python (ou un autre langage), SQL et les statistiques de base ; vous connaissez les bases de données relationnelles et les notions d’ETL ; vous êtes rigoureux(se), curieux(se) et vous aimez les projets techniques ; connaître le cloud, Spark ou Docker est un plus ; les débutants sont acceptés. Rythme : 4 jours en entreprise et 1 jour en formation. Processus de recrutement : étude de votre CV, test QCM, puis entretien. Vous avez une réponse sous 48 h après l’entretien. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Engineering Manager Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours) About FullEnrich: Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster. What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment. Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in. The Role: You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth. You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work. This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization. What You'll Do: People Leadership & Development Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, feedback, and career development. Build a supportive, high-performing team environment where engineers have clear expectations, opportunities to grow, and the autonomy to do their best work. Take ownership of team health, engagement, and retention, proactively identifying and addressing challenges. Hiring & Team Growth Own the engineering side of hiring for your squads, including defining requirements, setting assessment criteria, interviewing, and making hiring decisions. Develop effective onboarding processes that help new engineers become productive and autonomous quickly. jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid know

jobs.title: Workforce & Business Analyst
jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope. This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support. You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success. What you'll ship Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget. Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations. Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence. Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend. Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle. What you'll bring 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field. You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight. Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained. Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar). You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it. You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Jij bent een technisch zwaargewicht die de kwaliteit, performance en toekomstbestendigheid van onze moderne SaaS-architectuur bewaakt. Je gaat over de technische beslissingen rondom ons eigen low-code platform en bent dé kartrekker van de groep. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst. jobs.description: Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken?   Hier krijg jij energie van Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren. Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven. Wat je concreet gaat doen:  Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code; Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen; Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment  Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te  valideren voor ons platform. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol  Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien. Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje:  Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring;  Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework; Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels. Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events. jobs.title: Stage: Bedrijfsprocessen & Veiligheid
jobs.description: Over Nedlin Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdracht Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart. Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten. Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij? Stagevergoeding: € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week); € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week); Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa; Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht; Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen; Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes; Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match. Veiligheid tijdens je stage Veiligheid staat ook tijdens de uitvoering van de stageopdracht voorop. Je voert daarom geen risicovolle onderhoudswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Eventuele technische aanpassingen worden uitsluitend uitgevoerd door bevoegde medewerkers of externe partijen. Machinekaarten worden vóór ingebruikname gevalideerd door de Technische Dienst. Wie ben jij? Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Engineering of Facility Management. Je hebt interesse in techniek en veiligheid en combineert graag theorie met praktijk. Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s. Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- en/of afstudeerstage. Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo of Hoensbroek reizen. Pak het moment Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst
jobs.description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build

jobs.title: Audit Methodology Lead
jobs.description: We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar. You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
jobs.description: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits. We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform. Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers. We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable. Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker. Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery. We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output. What you'll do: Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases Keep performance in mind across the stack Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort What you bring: You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. jobs.title: Performance Creative Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du denkst in Hooks, Angles und Testing-Loops und willst sehen, was deine Ideen im Ad Account bewegen? Unsere Produkte werden in über 100 Ländern genutzt - von Trainings-Equipment bis Streetwear. Paid Ads sind unser Hebel für Skalierung. Auf Instagram erreichen wir bereits über 270.000 Menschen, und mit starken Creatives auf Meta und Google wollen wir noch mehr Menschen für Calisthenics und GORNATION begeistern. Wir suchen einen Performance Creative Manager , der unsere Ad Production von der ersten Idee bis zur Auswertung steuert. Du entwickelst Konzepte, planst Shootings, briefst unsere Cutter und sorgst dafür, dass regelmäßig neue Ads live gehen. Konzepte entwickeln: Du recherchierst Trends, Formate und Ad Libraries und entwickelst daraus Konzepte, Hooks und Angles für Meta und Google. Shootings & UGC organisieren: Du planst und begleitest interne Ad Shootings und stimmst dich mit unseren Athleten zu Organic Reposts und UGC ab. Feedback-Loops mit Cuttern: Du briefst unsere Cutter, gibst Feedback zu Ad-Versionen und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst. Performance auswerten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Media Buyer analysierst du die Ergebnisse, leitest Learnings ab und bringst sie direkt in die nächsten Konzepte ein. Aktionen begleiten: Bei allen Kampagnen mit Paid-Anteil bist du von Anfang an dabei und planst die passenden Creatives rechtzeitig. Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Ad-Konzeption: Du hast bereits Ads konzipiert oder mit UGC gearbeitet, idealerweise im D2C-Umfeld, und weißt, warum ein Creative performt. Organisation & Projektmanagement: Du behältst Konzepte, Shootings und Deadlines parallel im Blick und setzt klare Prioritäten. Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du treibst Themen eigenständig voran und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen. Bezug zur Szene: Du bist in der Fitness- oder Calisthenics-Welt zuhause und verstehst unsere Community. Kommunikationsstärke: Du stimmst dich mit Media Buyer, Cuttern, Athleten, Content Team und externen Partnern ab und bleibst auch bei kurzfristigen Änderungen klar. Hands-on & belastbar: Shooting-Deadlines und viele Stakeholder bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig. Solide Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, um Hooks, Scripts und Briefings sicher umzusetzen. Background: Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg - entscheidend ist deine praktische Erfahrung. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung im Schnitt, mit Asana oder anderen Projekttools sowie ein Grundverständnis für Fotografie und Videografie. Benefits Top Arbeits-Equipment: Du bekommst ein MacBook für deine Arbeit, das dir hilft, produktiv und effizient zu arbeiten. Fitness inklusive: Wir trainieren regelmäßig gemeinsam nach der Arbeit, entweder in unserem Fitnessraum im Office-Gebäude oder draußen. Steuerfreier Sachbezug: Du erhältst eine Sport-Mitgliedschaft, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung oder eine Tankkarte als steuerfreien Sachbezug. Teamevents & Networking: Neben tollen Teamevents bekommst du auch die Gelegenheit, mit internationalen Calisthenics-Athleten in Kontakt zu treten und von ihnen zu lernen. Erlebe die FIBO: Mit deinem 4-Tage-Ticket für die FIBO - der größten Fitnessmesse der Welt - hast du Zugang zur Fitness-Welt in Köln. Komfort bei der Arbeit: Jeder Arbeitsplatz ist mit einem höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch ausgestattet, damit du zwischen Sitzen und Stehen wechseln kannst, um produktiv und gesund zu bleiben. Kaff

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast. We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. Not tickets. Outcomes. We call the role Product Engineer on purpose. You work directly with product, design, and practices, and you’re accountable for whether what you built actually solves the problem – not just for whether the code merged. What you’ll build Everyone works across the whole product; people build deeper expertise in some areas, but who works on what can change quickly. Over a typical quarter you’ll touch things like: • PMS integrations – connecting Roger to the practice management systems German practices run on, so our workflows sit on top of live practice data instead of beside it • Treatment plans and cost estimates (HKP) – turning a manual, error-prone paper process into something a practice team gets right the first time • Patient communication – recalls, reminders, and follow-ups that practices today handle by phone, fax, and sticky note • Revenue and billing workflows – helping practices bill what they actually did, correctly and on time • The Roger apps – web and Flutter clients that practice staff use all day, every day Whatever your area, you’ll own it from the first conversation with a practice to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked. What we expect • Own outcomes, not tasks. You define scope, timelines, and success criteria for your area, and you align stakeholders around them • Make technical decisions and stand behind them. Architecture, trade-offs, what to build versus buy – you decide, document why, and course-correct when the data says so • Know the system, not just your service. Roger is one product. You keep enough context across PMS integrations, data model, and clients to make decisions that hold up outside your corner • Raise the bar continuously. Testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability – you leave every area better than you found it • Shape how we work with AI. Our tooling and practices are still evolving. You contribute to them actively rather than waiting for a playbook • Enable others. Code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing – a senior here makes the people around them better How we work AI-native engineering, honestly described. Most of us run several coding agents in parallel, all day. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Reviewing it, testing it, and deciding what not to ship is. So here’s what that actually means for you: • You write specs and plans before you prompt. Skipping design thinking is where projects fail – not the AI • You review agent output with the same rigor as any PR. If you can’t explain what a module does, it doesn’t ship • You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system • Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance • You know the spectrum: when a throwaway prototype is fine and when full engineering discipline applies • You expect to spend as much time reviewing and validating as writing. If that sounds like a downgrade, this isn’t the right team. If it sounds like leverage, read on Patient data is not a detail. Roger handles health data (GDPR Art. 9) and sits inside practices bound by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB). Data minimization, access control, EU processing, and a clear head about what may go to which model provider are part of the engineering bar here – not a compliance checkbox someone else owns. Small team, short paths. You talk to practices, to product, and to the people

jobs.title: Country Manager - Germany (Shift)
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. This is an incredible opportunity, to own Shift’s German operation, from business acquisition and data collection through logistics, team-building and delivery. Requirements Strong operational ownership: able to make local decisions, coordinate teams and take responsibility for delivery. Ability to win participation from businesses, particularly mid-sized businesses doing skilled, non-domestic tasks. Commercial judgment: build a local operation while operating as lean as possible. Practical logistics capability: maximise hardware, including distribution, returns, cleaning, uploads and loss prevention. Comfort building a team where justified by the economics, while working closely with Shift’s central team. Willingness to do hands-on, repetitive operational work, not only strategy or automation. Who Will Thrive at microagi Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Our Mission: Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world. Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not. Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report. We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it. It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX. We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport . Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date. About the role Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked. The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet. A small team that ships fast . We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user. What you’ll do Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying Engineer how we feed context to AI models : how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention Evolve our workflow builder : something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections Design the architecture behind the product : how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful. Who you are You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath. You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges. You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t. You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states. You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API. Interview process An initial call with our talent team. A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python. An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO). jobs.description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p><strong>ROLE SUMMARY</strong></p> <p>The Senior AI Security Engineer, AI Products &amp; Applications will be embedded within the AI &amp; Applications team to enable the secure design, development, release, and operation of AI products and applications. The role works directly with AI engineers, application engineers, product managers, inference engineers, DevOps, and platform teams to build practical security controls into agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model-serving APIs, enterprise-data integrations, and user-facing AI experiences.</p> <p>This is a product- and application-oriented security role. The engineer will help teams deliver trusted AI features without unnecessarily slowing innovation, while ensuring that AI products protect customer, enterprise, and operational data. jobs.description: <p>Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.</p> <p>So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.</p> <p>Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll be the tip of the spear for Square's most strategic, high-value deals. You'll navigate multi-threaded sales cycles with executive stakeholders involving technical integrations and cross-functional alignment. This is a role for a seasoned enterprise seller who owns the full deal lifecycle — from cold outreach to signed contract — and thrives in the complexity that comes with it.</p> <p>You'll join a high-performing enterprise sales team that is deeply supported and strategically prioritized. Square is making significant investments to bring Square upmarket at scale and enable enterprise sales success. This is a team that operates with rigor, moves with urgency, and takes pride in signing the largest deals for the company.</p> <p><strong>You Will</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Craft and Lead Deal Strategy:</strong> Develop sophisticated, insight-led sales narratives tailored to client business priorities. jobs.title: Creative Director, Tidal
jobs.description: <p><strong>Company Description</strong></p> <p>Tidal was founded for artists by artists as the next innovative streaming platform to bring value back to the music industry. We empower artists with the products, resources, services, and content required to take control of their careers and connect more deeply with fans. Available in over 60+ countries, Tidal continues to help artists break down economic barriers to continue creating what's next in culture. Tidal is part of Block, Inc. (NYSE: SQ), a global technology company with a focus on financial services.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Tidal is a small, nimble design team building at the intersection of music, technology, and culture—shipping across uploads, streaming, AI-powered creative tools, and financial services that connect artists directly with their audiences in 60+ countries.&nbsp;We're looking for a Creative Director to help set the vision and quality bar across Tidal's product and brand ecosystem. This is a rare opportunity to be a foundational creative voice on a small team where your work will have outsized impact—shaping not just pixels but the future of how artists build careers. You'll drive complex initiatives from concept to ship, influence cross-functional strategy, and directly elevate the craft of everyone around you.</p> <p>This is an individual contributor role. You'll lead project teams and set the creative standard.</p> <p><strong>You Will</strong></p> <ul> <li>Originate brand platforms and campaign-level ideas, and own them from concept through 360 activation</li> <li>Reposition, reshape the brand and bring a tapped in culture and keep the platform coherent across brand and product surfaces</li> <li>Hold the idea intact from first cut to final placement</li> <li>Shape the brief alongside an embedded creative-strategy team</li> <li>Design and when needed direct designers, writers, and production partners on the work</li> <li>Work with marketing, product, and partnerships leadership to get campaigns made</li> </ul> <p><strong>You Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>A portfolio of work you led as a creative director: brand platforms, repositionings, campaigns, activations</li> <li>An art direction background and the visual judgment to lead the idea in any medium</li> <li>A track record setting creative vision and quality standards for a brand, while staying hands-on with the work</li> <li>Credibility with cross-functional leadership as a peer</li> <li>A history of catching cultural shifts early and putting them in the work</li> <li>Experience carrying brand thinking across multiple products or business lines</li> <li>Experience working in agencies, in-house, or both</li> </ul> <p><strong>How to Apply</strong></p> <p>Please submit your application along with a link to your portfolio. If your portfolio is password-protected, include the password in your application.<br><br></p> <p><strong>EEOC</strong></p> <p>We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is a proud equal opportunity employer. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, based solely on the core competencies required of the role at hand, and without regard to any legally protected class.<br><br>We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. jobs.description: <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Clear Street</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Why now We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it. What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. You’re finishing an undergraduate or master’s degree in a technical subject, such as engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or another natural science, or a quantitative subject such as economics, or you graduated in one in the last two years, with top results from a top university. Real client work from your first month, learning from people who have shipped 30+ AI products and embedded AI into 50+ businesses. Every engagement ends with AI running in production and results you can measure. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and a chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm. jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 7 000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Tu as une solide expérience en comptabilité et tu aimes comprendre comment fonctionnent les outils SaaS ? Tu souhaites intervenir sur des problématiques complexes, à la frontière entre métier, produit et technologie ? Rejoins Pennylane en tant qu’Expert·e Support Technique et Comptable. Nous recherchons une personne qui : dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ; a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ; est à l’aise avec les outils et problématiques techniques ; sait communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ; parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ; fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité. La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendr

jobs.title: Prudential Reporting & Banking Accountant H/F
jobs.description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Why is this role important for Pennylane? Pennylane is creating Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a subsidiary seeking ACPR authorisation as a payment institution and financing company, to serve its 1.6 million SMB customers base. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will lay the foundations of PFS’s accounting model, controls and reporting as the business is built. You ensure the reliability of PFS’s financial information, from product events and accounting entries through to financial and prudential reporting. You check daily that client funds are safeguarded and that PFS meets its own funds requirements and applicable prudential ratios. You flag risks early and help the Head of Finance anticipate capital needs. You report to Maxime Leclercq, GM PFS, and functionally to @Raphaël Nahum, Head of Finance, on accounting standards and methods aligned with group finance. How will you contribute to the project? You build from scratch the accounting model and controls with Product and Tech, then run daily accounting until volumes justify a dedicated operator. You own the figures and accounting decisions, and prepare the accounting-based prudential reports. You collaborate with our Regulatory Lead, who oversees reporting deadlines, completeness and reviews, the reports before submission. You would be a great fit if: You can work with incomplete information and make decisions, assumptions and open questions clear. You document accounting decisions and are able to defend them internally and externally, including to statutory auditors and the ACPR. What will your day-to-day responsibilities be? Build Design and test payment and financing accounting schemes in the Core Banking System, the accounting interpreter, working closely with Product and Tech teams Document the accounting impact of each product before launch. Reconcile the ledger, general ledger, bank accounts and reports. Keep each reported figure traceable to its transactions. Set up RUBA and COREP reporting, including dry runs, with the Regulatory Lead. Operational accounting Reconcile payment accounts (eg. SCT, SDD, cards, cheques) against the settlement account daily. Check safeguarding coverage, keep evidence and flag shortfalls. Check own funds requirements, applicable ratios and available buffers daily. Forecast the amount and timing of capital needs with the Head of Finance

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance. Why this role exists Pennylane is one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. As the company grows, the quality of its execution depends increasingly on how well its leadership team sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through across the organization. This role makes that system work. You’ll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives and closely with the executive committee to bring structure and momentum to Pennylane’s most important company-wide rhythms, from OKRs and leadership meetings to cross-functional steering and Board preparation. This is not a traditional strategy role or a position observing executives from the sidelines. It is a high-leverage operating role for someone who enjoys creating clarity, improving how teams work together, and making sure important decisions turn into action. What you'll own You’ll help the executive team operate with greater focus, clarity, and consistency. That means: Running our leadership rhythms. Structure the agendas, preparation, and follow-through for key executive and leadership forums. By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI , you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Valence)
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques.
