jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Comptable (Télétravail complet possible depuis Quimper)
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? - Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements. - Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements. - Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs. - Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe. - Tu contribues à la création et

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar). Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English is mandatory; French or German is a plus. Start date: Immediately Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable. This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate. Key Responsibilities: • Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release • Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals • Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls • Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams • Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD) • Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification • Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics • Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices Skills and Experience Required: • BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory • Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems • Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061) • Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering • Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures • Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus • Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts • Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus • Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus Start date: Immediately Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact&nbsp;</li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers.&nbsp;</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>Your Mission</strong></h3> <p>At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build a self-service developer platform</strong> with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure</strong>, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.</li> <li><strong>Boost developer productivity</strong> by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.</li> <li><strong>Drive reliability and scalability</strong> through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.</li> <li><strong>Improve platform operations</strong> usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate and innovate</strong> by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h3> <p>You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Database
jobs.description: About MotherDuck Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck , we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans. What you will do The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next. Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built. This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe. Key Responsibilities: Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud. Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances. Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end. Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals. Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation. Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most. Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems. Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team. Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next. What you bring You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like. You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.) A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques. Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at. You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems. You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies. You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs. jobs.description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. jobs.title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
jobs.description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods. Assignment The assignment will include the following tasks: A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated. A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet. Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts. Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification. Results The final outcomes of this assignment will be: §  A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case. §  An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm. §  A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work. Duration For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months. Profile You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master. You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus. You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn. You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice. What we offer A challenging graduation pr

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen. Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt. Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen. Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd. Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging. Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen. Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken. Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen. Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening. Wat vragen we van jou? Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
jobs.description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. jobs.title: Product Specialist
jobs.description: Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room. YOUR MISSION Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform. Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product. WHAT YOU'LL DO Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find. Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts. Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have. Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why. Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time. Support demos. Join Sales in complex demos and present our roadmap and product decisions to customers and prospects. HOW WE WORK Close to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week. Evidence over opinions. We decide what to build based on customer evidence and usage data, not on who asks loudest. AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. WHY US? Real impact: You work directly with our Head of Product and shape what we build, based on what you hear from customers. A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events. Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. jobs.description: Über moinAI moinAI ist die Agentic AI Plattform für Kundenservice und Marketing. Unsere AI-Agents beantworten Anfragen nicht nur, sondern lösen sie eigenständig: integriert in die Systeme unserer Kund:innen, kontrollierbar, DSGVO-konform und Made in Germany. Über 170 Unternehmen setzen auf uns, von Octopus Energy und ImmoScout24 über Hays und TEAG bis zum Chocoversum in Hamburg. Deine Rolle Du willst Marketing nicht nur verwalten, sondern Sichtbarkeit schaffen? Dann suchen wir Dich als Online Marketing Manager:in. Hier übernimmst Du keinen fertigen Redaktionsplan: Du entscheidest, wie moinAI in Google, in LLMs und auf LinkedIn auftaucht und machst unsere Expertise mit eigenem Content sichtbar. Vom ersten Keyword bis zum Newsletter verantwortest Du unsere organischen Kanäle. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst unsere SEO- und GEO-Strategie weiter, damit moinAI in Google und in KI-Suchen wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Overviews sichtbar ist. Du planst und steuerst Content entlang der Customer Journey: Blogartikel, Landingpages, Case Studies und Whitepaper. Zudem pflegst Du unsere Website in Webflow. Du verantwortest Redaktionsplan, Posts und Community-Management unserer LinkedIn-Unternehmensseite und unterstützt Geschäftsführung und Team beim Aufbau ihrer persönlichen Profile. Du konzipierst und versendest unseren Newsletter. Du misst den Erfolg aller Kanäle (GA4, Search Console, HubSpot) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Was Du mitbringst Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen Nachweisbare Erfolge in SEO und Content sowie Interesse an GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Erfahrung im Aufbau einer B2B-Marke auf LinkedIn und mit Newsletter bzw. jobs.title: Senior Document Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We’re Hiring: Senior Document Manager (m/f/d) Offshore Wind | Onshore & Offshore Projects | Permanent Position T.I.S. GmbH has been a specialised consulting and service company in offshore wind energy for over 20 years . We support international clients in the planning, execution and quality assurance of complex energy projects and work with leading companies in the industry. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Senior Document Manager (m/f/d) who runs documentation processes professionally and acts as the central interface within the project. jobs.description: About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer. We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards. You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include: Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise. Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk. Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail. Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work. We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community. You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and experimental teams across the company. About You You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential

jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.description: Senior Internal Auditor  Our passion at SumUp is championing small businesses. We believe in creating technology that is flexible, fair, affordable and easy to use. Every day millions of people around the world dream of starting their own businesses. We strive to help them to do this. Our long-term goal is to close the loop by enabling businesses to turn transactions with customers into long-term relationships.  We are looking for a Senior Internal Auditor to join our team at SumUp and help us ensure compliance, assess risks, and strengthen internal controls within the organisation, with a particular focus on European regulation. The Senior Internal Auditor will help implement the best industry practices for a robust and proactive internal auditing function at SumUp. The Senior Auditor will report directly to the Global Head of Internal Audit. This person will work closely with the Board, Audit Committee, key stakeholders and external auditors. This is an individual contributor role. If you're looking for a role where your work genuinely matters and your voice is heard, this is it. What you'll do: Plan and conduct regulatory, compliance, and operational audits across SumUp's European markets Prepare audit reports, present findings to management, and recommend improvements Contribute towards the development and improvement of the Internal Audit plan, framework, methodology and templates Coordinate internal audit-related projects together with the relevant teams Manage relationships with stakeholders and foster a proactive culture towards internal controls and compliance You'll be great for this role if you have: Strong audit experience in financial services, ideally within payments or regulated fintech Deep knowledge of the European regulatory environment and internal controls frameworks Comfort operating in large, complex, international organisations where priorities shift Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to act as a credible partner at all levels A natural curiosity for data, with the ability to look beyond the numbers and draw sound conclusions Need for internal audit experience in-house, with the ability to help establish and grow this capability 💚 Why You Should Join SumUp 🇬🇧 London, United Kingdom 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. jobs.title: Lead, Business Operations - Payward Services
jobs.description: The team Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers. As a Lead, Business Operations, you’ll be the operating generalist for PWS. Your core is partner launch and the operating rhythm behind the business, and from there you’ll take on whatever PWS needs to scale: launch readiness, operating cadence, reporting, and strategic projects with leadership. You’ll report to the head of PWS Business Operations and work with Sales, Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance, and the outcomes are yours. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview You will own the Hozah data platform. At its centre is the BigQuery and Dataform warehouse: you'll model raw data into the management-information measures and KPI views the business runs on, and build the Metabase dashboards on top of them. We run ELT on managed connectors, so ingestion is yours too, but it is mostly configuration rather than pipeline engineering. The Pub/Sub streams and the Terraform that provisions them stay with our engineering team, and you request and review those changes rather than write them. You are the person finance, operations and the wider business go to when they need to trust a number. This role exists because the platform has outgrown what one person can carry alongside everything else. Demand for management information has grown faster than ad-hoc effort can keep up with, and the business needs numbers it does not have to double-check. We are hiring a senior engineer to take full ownership, make those numbers reliable, and build the dashboard layer the business runs on. You'll work alongside backend engineers on the source systems that feed the warehouse, and directly with the CFO, COO, Client Service and the wider leadership team as the people who depend on what you build. This is a newly created role with no direct reports. In your first quarter, you'll agree one new data capability with the CTO, and take it into production over your first year. Key Responsibilities Own the Hozah data platform, from ingestion through to the dashboards the business relies on. Take full ownership of the BigQuery and Dataform warehouse, including CI and the path a change takes from a branch to production. Look after ingestion from source systems, mostly through managed tools such as Airbyte or Fivetran for SaaS connectors, alongside database replication and file loads. Produce every department's KPIs from versioned, tested models, and deliver them on Metabase with no manual spreadsheet step in between. Set and monitor freshness expectations for every ingested source, so a stale source alerts a named owner rather than surfacing in a board pack. Work with the CFO, COO, CRO and other stakeholders to define and defend metric definitions, pushing back where a requested number would mislead. Agree one new data capability with the CTO in your first quarter, then see it into production and adopted by a named business owner. Be the platform's sole owner: triage issues, promote changes safely, and be the person the business trusts for numbers. Who we're looking for You've owned a data warehouse or platform alone, or as its lead, including being the one who fixes it when it breaks. You can say exactly what you were accountable for and what you personally changed. You write deep SQL and model data properly on a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake, inside a versioned transformation framework such as Dataform or dbt, with CI around it. You can explain how you turned raw data into measures the business trusts, how a change gets from a branch to production, and what stops a bad one getting there. You've made a disputed number trusted. You can walk through a specific incident from the last 12 months: how you found it, what the root cause was, and what now stops it happening again. You work directly with non-technical stakeholders, and you've refused or reshaped a metric definition you thought was wrong. You can say what you said, and what happened next. jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Saint-Malo)
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? - Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements. - Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements. - Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs. - Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe. - Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation

jobs.description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... ‍‍‍ Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor. 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Your impact Every great employee experience starts with great IT. At Pennylane, our mission is to make technology simple, seamless and secure, so our teams can focus on building the future of finance. As an IT Support Administrator , you'll be one of the main points of contact for our employees. You'll help them stay productive, improve the way we work and contribute to building an IT environment that scales with our growth. What you'll do Deliver an outstanding IT experience Whether it's resolving technical issues, answering questions or helping employees get the most out of our tools, you'll make sure every Pennylaner has a smooth IT experience. Employee onboarding & offboarding You'll make sure every employee has everything they need before day one. From day one to the last day, you'll make sure every employee has everything they need to work successfully. You'll prepare laptops, provision accounts, manage permissions and introduce new joiners to our IT environment and security best practices. You'll also handle offboarding and manage IT operations for freelancers and external partners. Keep our IT environment secure Security is everyone's responsibility. You'll play an important role in making security part of everyone's daily habits. You'll help monitor compliance with our internal IT policies, manage software access, review permissions and contribute to maintaining a secure environment for the whole company. Manage our internal tools You'll administer our SaaS ecosystem by creating accounts, managing permissions and ensuring employees have the right access at the right time. You'll also help improve how we manage and document our internal tools. Share knowledge You'll contribute to building a strong IT culture across the company. That means writing clear documentation, improving our knowledge base, delivering onboarding sessions and helping employees adopt best practices around IT and security. Who are you? We're looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong IT fundamentals. Someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people and continuously improving the employee experience. You won't know every tool we use on day one, and that's perfectly fine. What matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability

jobs.title: Technicien d'essais sur avion H/F
jobs.description: Dans le cadre de nos différentes activités, nous sommes aujourd’hui reconnus comme des acteurs incontournables dans le domaine des essais aéronautiques sur FAL A320/A330/A321, avant la livraison des avions neufs. Sous-traitant du plus grand constructeur d'avions , notre ambition est d'acquérir de nouveaux marchés et contribuer au quotidien à la satisfaction de nos clients. Pour cela, nous pouvons compter sur nos équipes qui contribuent au quotidien à la performance et à la croissance de notre structure. Sous la responsabilité du chef d’équipe, les techniciens d’essais aéronautiques réalisent les essais nécessaires en vue de l'attestation de conformité du produit. Vos missions 𝐑𝐞́𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐬 : - Dérouler les procédures de test sur A320/A330/A321, - Procéder à la pose & dépose des outillages et équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des essais, - Réaliser les essais fonctionnels sur les systèmes de l'avion en vue de l'attestation de conformité, - Rechercher les pannes (recherche de plan, trouble shooting, sonnage, mesure de tension, etc.). 𝐒𝐮𝐢𝐯𝐢 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐞́𝐬 : - Rédiger les différents avis suite aux problèmes rencontrés, - Assurer le suivi informatique des essais (attestation des essais, réalisation de reprise d'essais, archivage, etc.), - Procéder à l'amélioration continue des process industriels, - Participer aux passages avion pour transferts des points vers les postes suivants, - Piloter l'activité des assistants essais sur le poste. Vos compétences Le type de profil que nous recherchons : - Formation aéronautique (avionique, mécanique, système) ou électrotechnique, idéalement BAC+2 - Connaissances dans les essais systèmes : commandes de vol, trains…. - Connaissance de la FAL - Un bon relationnel et une capacité à travailler en équipe - Un réel intérêt pour le secteur aéronautique - Des prédispositions et habiletés pour le travail manuel et/ou une expérience en électricité/électronique Avantages Panier-repas d'un montant de 6€ par jour travaillé. jobs.title: Master Key User SAP FI/CO
jobs.description: Über die Bell Food Group und die Rolle Lust auf eine Schlüsselrolle, in der du Finanzprozesse aktiv mitgestaltest und als Bindeglied zwischen Finance, Business und IT agierst? Bei Hügli in Steinach, welche Teil der Bell Food Group ist, wartet eine vielseitige Aufgabe auf dich, in der fundiertes SAP FI/CO-Know-how, ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis und starke Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten zusammenkommen. Als Master Key User bist du Dreh- und Angelpunkt, um unsere Finanzprozesse über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu harmonisieren. Deine Aufgaben: Prozess-Architektur: Du gestaltest und vereinheitlichst die SAP FI/CO-Module gruppenweit und stellst sicher, dass unsere Systeme optimal auf die Bedürfnisse der Landesgesellschaften abgestimmt sind Standardisierung: Die Entwicklung globaler Richtlinien und Best Practices liegt in deiner Hand, um konzernweit für maximale Transparenz und Effizienz zu sorgen Business Partnering: Als zentraler Ansprechpartner schlägst du die Brücke zwischen Fachbereichen, IT und den lokalen Finanzteams Support & Training: Du befähigst die lokalen Key User durch gezielte Schulungen (DE/EN) und fungierst als kompetenter 1st Level Support bei komplexen Fragestellungen, zusätzlich fungierst du als Schnittstelle zwischen 1st und 2nd Level Support Projektleitung: Spannende SAP FI/CO Roll-outs in Ländern wie Italien, den Niederlanden oder UK sowie der Aufbau moderner Controlling- und Analyse-Tools (z.B. BI, -Profitcenterrechnung etc.) prägen deine Agenda für die kommenden Jahre Konsolidierung: Du begleitest gruppenweite Konsolidierungsprozesse, stellst eine konsistente Datenbasis sicher und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung der entsprechenden Prozesse und Systemlösungen, beispielsweise in Jedox Das bringst du mit: SAP FI/CO Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte und mehrjährige Erfahrung mit SAP FI/CO - idealerweise als Key User, Master Key User oder in einer vergleichbaren fachnahen Funktion. Dein Fokus liegt dabei auf Prozessen und deren Weiterentwicklung; tiefgreifende Programmier- oder Customizing-Kenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus Zahlen-Affinität: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für finanzwirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, Analysen und Kennzahlen. Du musst kein klassischer Controller sein - entscheidend ist, dass du dich sicher in der Welt der Zahlen bewegst und Finance-Prozesse fachlich verstehst Konsolidierung & Reporting: Du kennst dich mit Konsolidierungs-, Planungs- und Reportingprozessen aus und hast idealerweise bereits mit entsprechenden BI- oder Performance-Management-Lösungen wie beispielsweise Jedox gearbeitet Analytischer Scharfsinn: Komplexe Geschäftsprozesse zu durchdringen und in smarte Systemlösungen zu übersetzen, bereitet dir Freude Internationaler Spirit: Da wir global agieren, sind verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse und Freude an der interkulturellen Zusammenarbeit für dich selbstverständlich Macher-Mentalität: Du bringst die nötige Veränderungsbereitschaft mit, um neue Standards nicht nur einzuführen, sondern auch nachhaltig im Unternehmen zu verankern Projekt-Erfahrung: Du verfügst über fundierte Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und bist es gewohnt, komplexe Projekte und unterschiedliche Stakeholder strukturiert zu koordinieren Das bieten wir: Work-Life-Balance: Bei uns profitierst du von einer 40-Stunden Woche, mind. 25 Urlaubstagen und einem Gleitzeitsystem. jobs.title: Automation Engineer - GMP Pharma & Biotech
jobs.description: agap2 is a European engineering and operational consulting group founded in 2005 and specialized in the industry. We work in the Pharma, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Energy, Infrastructure, Transportation, Chemicals, and Information Technology sectors. As a consultant, you will have to support our clients in the realization of their projects on site by bringing your expertise and your skills. You are agile and eager to adapt to different work environments that will fuel your curiosity of seeing what’s behind closed doors of the biggest projects of our client’s portfolio. Tasks You will work on the design, implementation, qualification and improvement of automation systems in GMP-regulated environments. Depending on your background, your expertise may focus on PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES or industrial networks. You will collaborate with engineering, production, quality and validation teams on complex investment and improvement projects. Your responsibilities Design, develop and implement automation solutions in GMP environments. Contribute to the configuration and programming of PLC, HMI, SCADA, DCS or MES systems. Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, qualification and validation activities. Troubleshoot automation, control and communication issues. Develop and improve automation standards, procedures and technical documentation. Support batch control, recipe management, data integrity and process monitoring activities. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and client stakeholders. Contribute to the delivery of strategic pharmaceutical and biotech projects. Requirements Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial IT or a related field. Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life science environment. Professional experience with at least one of the following: PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, MES, industrial automation or OT networks. Knowledge of automation systems and industrial communication technologies.Experience with one or more platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Emerson DeltaV or Syncade is an advantage. Understanding of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity and qualification/validation principles. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Ability to work independently in a consulting and project-based environment. Good communication skills in English; German is a strong advantage. Benefits Joining a group with strong development potential that aims to improve your employability on challenging and varied projects Joining a structure that has been established in Switzerland for a long time with a client portfolio that includes leaders in the sector Having a sustainable job with stability and access to a real collaboration Benefit from training with accredited and certified centers Having a local management team to support you in the achievement of your missions and in the development of your career Being part of a dynamic, committed team with real human values that we live by every day Only applications from Swiss and EU citizens will be considered. jobs.title: Working Student - Business and Office Administrator (40-50%)
jobs.description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 120+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 9 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. You keep the office running and make sure Wingtra stays a great place to work. Your days mix administrative work, office management and event organizing. You bring an organized, hands-on approach, look after the ambiance, the goodies and the events, and get the chance to keep improving them. You're also the first point of contact for Wingtranauts and business partners on anything to do with administration and the office. Responsibilities Answer the everyday questions.  You handle basic inquiries from team members on behalf of Wingtra, like office and IT equipment and mail, so people get a quick answer from someone who knows. Keep the paperwork moving.  You open the mail, scan invoices and upload them to the right folder. You also check receipts. jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run product

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers. What you will do Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses. Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool. Your profile MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field. ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation. Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux. Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ). Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware. Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks. Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you. Bonus Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition. Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering. High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development. Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data. Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment. Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team. What we offer Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product. Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven. A competitive salary for the Dutch market. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. jobs.description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein. Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie. Sturing en beheersing Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten; Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuu
